title: Certificates of Deposit: a maturity payout instruction that names a closed account
content:
## Situation this policy governs

This policy applies to a Certificates of Deposit certificate whose maturity instruction pays the balance out to a checking or savings account, where that payout account has since been closed. It governs which maturity instruction the certificate carries on record, so that what happens when the grace period ends is something the bank can carry out. The change is recorded on the certificate with the tool described below and is visible on the certificate record at once.

## Tool: update_maturity_instruction_96ab509d

### What it does

The tool records a new maturity instruction and payout account on a certificate of deposit. It replaces what the certificate does when its grace period ends (renew automatically, pay the balance to checking or savings, or mail an official check) and the PCB account named as the certificate's payout account. The certificate's interest disposition is left as it is.

### How it is invoked

update_maturity_instruction_96ab509d is an internal tool: the agent must first unlock it and then call it.

### Parameters

**certificate_id** — identifier: the certificate reference number whose instruction changes, as returned by the certificate lookup for this customer.

**renewal_instruction** — one value from this complete set:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| auto_renew | The certificate renews into its renewal tier when the grace period ends |
| pay_out_to_checking | The whole balance is paid to the payout checking account when the grace period ends |
| pay_out_to_savings | The whole balance is paid to the payout savings account when the grace period ends |
| mail_check | The whole balance is paid by official check mailed to the address on file when the grace period ends |

**payout_account_id** — identifier: the account reference number of the customer's own PCB checking or savings account to record as the payout account, as returned by the checking or savings account lookup.

### What it returns

A successful call returns a receipt, rendered as text, with certificate_id (the certificate updated), renewal_instruction (the instruction now on record), payout_account_id (the payout account now on record) and recorded_at (the moment of the change, exactly as the system clock reads). A receipt echoing the new instruction means the change is recorded.

## Contract questions

**Does a call change where monthly interest is paid?**
No. The tool leaves the interest disposition as it is; it records only the maturity instruction and the payout account.

**Does the tool check whether the instruction is right for the certificate?**
No. It records the values supplied; which instruction the certificate should carry is a matter of policy.
